basics.name: Jordan Price
basics.label: Bioinformatician and AI Engineer
basics.summary: Bioinformatics Team Lead at Niab, Cambridge, UK. I work on fungal and plant genomics and build pipelines and computational tools for research groups across the institute. My research focuses on the comparative genomics of pathogenic Fusarium species.

education.summary: The role of chromatin modifications on gene expression in early Xenopus development.

work.name: Niab, Crop Improvement, Cambridge
work.summary: Leading the Bioinformatics Team and building computational tools for research groups across the institute. Current projects include dsRNA design for RNAi-based control of Fusarium and Phytophthora (Innovate UK mycoDOT), assembly of tetraploid honeyberry (Lonicera caerulea) genomes, and a pan-genome survey of NLR resistance genes in common bean.

work.name: Niab, Plant Pathology, Cambridge
work.summary: Led the BBSRC-funded collaboration with Marlow Foods (Quorn), identifying the genetic cause of the C-variant phenotype in Fusarium venenatum through whole-genome sequencing and CRISPR editing. Comparative genomics of Fusarium pathogens, genome assembly of soft fruit and rust fungi, and development of Nextflow pipelines and AI research tools.

work.name: Niab, Cambridge Crop Research, Cambridge
work.summary: Worked on the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation-funded ENSA project, using comparative genomics to investigate the evolutionary underpinnings of actinorhizal nitrogen fixing symbiosis.

work.name: Niab, Genetics, Genomics and Breeding, East Malling
work.summary: Worked on the ENSA project, using comparative genomics to investigate the evolutionary underpinnings of actinorhizal nitrogen fixing symbiosis.

work.name: University of Kent, School of Biosciences
work.summary: Explored the genetic and genomic modifications underpinning the pathogenicity of the human fungal pathogen Candida albicans.

work.name: University of Southampton, Faculty of Medicine
work.summary: Designed and performed high throughput multiplex TaqMan qPCR assays, Western blot optimisation and analysis, and computational analysis of expression microarray and DNA methylation data.
